archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_road.1: To whoever wakes the gate after us. You came the long way, by fire and by falling. We came through the ring, as we went everywhere: one step, and a new sky.
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_road.2: This is the Archive. Everything we learned is written in its halls. Read slowly. There is no one left to hurry you.
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_builde: We were not born on this rock. Nothing is. We cut our halls here because it was close and quiet, and because the blue world fills half the sky.
We were stonecutters first, and then cutters of distance. Every gate is the same ring: the stone of the world it stands on, bound in our script.
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.many_world: Count the lights on the orrery. Each was a world we walked. Ash plains that burned underfoot. Seas under ice. A forge the size of a mountain range.
None of them was home, and all of them were. A child could wake on one world and sleep on another, and think nothing of it.
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_keeper: A gate left alone is a door left open. So we made keepers: stone that walks, and remembers one order. Let no one through who cannot open the way.
If you are reading this, you have met them. We are sorry. They were never meant to outlast us.
It began with the farthest gate. It did not break. It stopped answering. Those we sent through did not come back, and the ring stayed dark.
Then the next one. Then the next. Always from the outside in, as if something were walking the road toward us.
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_last_o: The order came from the forge world, the last voice to come through: put out the gates. All of them. Do not wait for us.
We argued for a day we did not have. Then we did as we were told. The rings went dark one by one, and the sky felt very large.
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.the_sealin: We have sealed the Archive and set the keepers. The gate on the blue world we never opened, and now we never will.
Whatever walks the road must not find the way there. If it already has, this record is for no one. We write it anyway.
archive.ascension_worlds.moon.unfinished: I am the last one here. The air is going. I can hear the gate across the hall, though it is dark, though we put it out ourselves.
